answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake in escrow before it can bid on work, and slash that stake when a peer attests to fraud. A new identity begins at its nadir: no stake, no trust, no jobs worth taking. Honest work slowly releases the bond plus a fee, so a single agent's haven is built over time, and a long honest record is what carries an agent to its zenith. A sybil attacker who spawns a thousand fake identities must fund a thousand separate stakes, and any one that cheats burns its deposit — the cost scales with the attack, not with the defender.
